'''Pel Kwinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], orginially from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], who served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. BY [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Kwinn, who had achieved the [[Police rank|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], retired from the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] and returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Roughly a [[18 BBY/Legends|year later]], [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]] issued a [[Coruscant Security Force uniform]] to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] who assumed Kwinn's identity in order to infiltrate the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|headquarters]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] on Coruscant.<ref name="LastJedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pel Kwinn was first mentioned in the [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], a novel by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]] that was released on [[February 26]], [[2013]].
